title: Finite element exponential integration for rough solutions of nonlinear wave equations. Part I: Dirichlet boundary conditions on polygonal and polyhedral domains
summary: We study a fully discrete scheme for nonlinear wave equations on general bounded polygonal/polyhedral domains with initial data $(u^0,v^0)\in H^γ(Ω)\times H^{γ-1}(Ω)$, $0<γ\le 1$, subject to the natural compatibility condition associated with the homogeneous Dirichlet boundary condition. The scheme combines an exponential Euler time integrator with a finite element spatial discretization. In contrast to existing low-regularity error analyses, which are mostly based on Fourier spectral discretizations, our approach applies to general bounded domains and finite element spatial discretizations.…
